summary: AAP supports OAuth tokens (tied to an application) and Personal Access Tokens (tied to a user); access tokens now expire after 1 year instead of 1000 (tokens created before 2.5.20250604 keep 1000 years), configurable with OAUTH2_PROVIDER__ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_SECONDS in settings.py.
questions: How long do AAP access tokens last?
How do I change the OAuth token expiration in AAP?
What is the difference between OAuth tokens and personal access tokens?

answer_card.title: Access token expiration
answer_card.answer_md:
Default is now **1 year** (was 1000 years; tokens created before 2.5.20250604 keep 1000 years). Change it in `settings.py`:
```python
OAUTH2_PROVIDER__ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_SECONDS = 31536000
```
